description: In the t3:docker nightly suite, live ClickHouse connection and schema creation emits a Python warning attributed to benchbox.platforms.clickhouse.setup. Because test teardowns failed with pytrace=False and CI emits no warnings summary, the underlying warning category and message text remain uncaptured. Reproduce on Linux with docker compose at -n 0, inspect the warning, and silence or resolve the source.
